question: Should `plugin-sdk/archive`, `plugin-sdk/root-walk`, and `plugin-sdk/secret-file` be accepted as supported long-term external plugin APIs in this migration?
rationale: Those exports create new compatibility commitments for external plugins; the available PR context documents their purpose but does not establish an explicit maintainer decision on the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK surface
options.body: Accept the three documented subpaths as stable plugin APIs and require lockfile/frozen-install proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the new helpers internal for now
options.body: Retain the fs-safe refactor but remove or defer public SDK exports until a separate API contract decision is made.

recommendation.title: Keep the new helpers internal for now
recommendation.body: Retain the fs-safe refactor but remove or defer public SDK exports until a separate API contract decision is made.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows this contributor carried the focused filesystem and SDK-seam design and is best placed to provide the implementation context for the owner decision.
